author: Gtabetter
quote: GTA 6 isn't just a video game; it's a spiritual awakening. The graphics are so insanely realistic that I looked out my window afterward and felt disgusted by how low-res real life is. The story is an absolute masterpiece that makes Shakespeare look like a middle school dropout—I cried, I laughed, I changed as a human being. Honestly, it completely humiliates outdated dinosaur games like Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Why swing a plastic sword in a stupid green hat when you can experience true art? Sell your house to buy this.

author: Gtabetter
quote: The gameplay is a total mess. You press a button and Link swings his sword. Wow, groundbreaking. We’ve seen swords in games before, guys. Try having an original thought for once. Also, why is he wearing a hat? It makes zero tactical sense and honestly killed my immersion immediately. Gta 6 better
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
